fields.label: What must the proposed specification change?

risks.mitigation: Follow the existing explicit detach instruction using origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 and record 10cddc5ff69124002c485b011dba5d34ebe6de75 as head_sha after checkout.
risks.description: The local branch ref cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 and the origin remote-tracking ref point to different commits, so selecting the unqualified local branch would audit the wrong revision.

risks.mitigation: Preserve the specification rule that inability is a known issue, capture the exact command output and counts, and never synthesize passing results.
risks.description: The observation suite or the ordered-delivery regression may be unable to start without its PostgreSQL test environment.

risks.mitigation: Apply the proposed Builder verification update so T1 receives actual test evidence, with any environment failure reported honestly.
risks.description: Without a T1-specific builder command, later assessment can cite committed T1 tests but cannot claim those tests ran in this audit.

body.summary: The audit specification is implementable with no blockers or operator decisions missing. The local remote-tracking target resolves to commit 10cddc5ff69124002c485b011dba5d34ebe6de75 and descends from epic/grade-pray. T1 and T2 match concrete code and regression coverage at that commit. One warning remains: the sole prescribed builder test command filters to the observation workspace and therefore does not execute the direct oakridge-dbos tests for T1.

findings.description: The prescribed command bun run --filter observation test covers T2 but not the direct T1 regressions, because T1 tests are in another workspace: oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83 verifies default-off and exact boolean preservation, oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:50-65 verifies launch mapping, and oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209 verifies ordered delivery and replay. As written, builder test_evidence can leave T1 unexecuted; add a T1 test command and report its real output or known inability.

T1 is otherwise precise and repository-aligned. oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-10 names grading_enabled on RunConfig, and oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:21-41 defaults an absent choice to false while rejecting non-booleans. oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-48 places the exact committed config beside the launched input.

The first half of T2 maps to an explicit exact-claim fence. observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:193-202 requires claimed status, matching lease owner, matching claim attempt, and an unexpired lease under a row lock; observation/src/grading/worker.ts:80-94 carries that same claim through request marking and settlement. observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:299-320 separately exercises expired, reclaimed, and old-attempt claims.

The second half of T2 is independently observable and testable. observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:227-253 updates execution and attempt state and inserts grade_observation inside one withTenant transaction. observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:226-239 forces an invalid append and verifies that neither completion nor answer commits before a valid retry commits both.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one cohort named audit with exactly tasks T1 and T2; no additional operator choice or confirmation is needed.
T1 assesses that launch config carries grading_enabled, defaults it off when absent, and preserves it through ordered launch delivery.
T2 assesses exact-current-claim fencing and atomic execution completion plus grade observation append.

Builder detaches at origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2, makes no repository or external mutations, runs the specified verification honestly, and publishes build_result plus existing PR 791.
Assessor evaluates the same head commit, reports at least one finding per task with path:start-end code citations and separate test or output evidence, and reports builder output as test_evidence.

source_spec_refs: Audit target, branch and isolated-verification purpose
T2 claim fencing and transactional completion criterion
Builder checkout, mutation prohibitions, test and existing-PR publication instructions
Assessor per-task code citation and test_evidence instructions

proposed_spec_updates.change: After bun run --filter observation test, run bun test oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts once and include its actual counts and output in build_result and test_evidence. If the database-backed publisher test cannot run, record that exact failure as a known issue rather than inventing a result.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: The current sole command filters to observation and cannot execute the direct T1 defaulting, mapping, or ordered-delivery regressions in oakridge-dbos.
